response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, technically strong full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years of experience across many languages and domains, but his resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal-level Growth/Experimentation role. His titles (Senior/Staff) and lack of demonstrated cross-team platform leadership at the scale implied by IC6 also fall short of the seniority and domain-specific bar required.
strengths: Extensive, diverse technical background across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems with 15+ years experience
Demonstrated experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks) and history of mentoring/teaching via workshops and talks
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk management experience, which is central to this role
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics platform work or growth-engineering focus in any listed role
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff titles rather than Principal-level cross-team platform ownership expected for IC6

key_factors.factor: No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or data-driven experimentation track record
Strong general engineering breadth and distributed systems experience
